fact: The Ministry of Information and Communication Infrastructure issued the National Broadband Policy 2020-2024 (BP-2024) in June 2020 for a five-year period ending in 2024, setting a 5 Mbps minimum for every user, 75% of homes with affordable 5 Mbps by 2022, near-100% by 2023 and 4G coverage of at least 85% of the population by 2024; the document names no successor.

The Gambia National Broadband Strategy 2020-2024, commissioned by the Ministry of Information and Communication Infrastructure in June 2020, covers 2020 to 2024 and sets targets of broadband coverage to more than 90% of the population by 2024, at least 75% of homes with affordable 5 Mbps download and upload speeds by 2022 and 4G coverage of at least 85% of the population by 2024; the document names no successor plan, and its own text refers to a review for the next five-year cycle.
